name: Cānghóng Lèi: Nì Tiān Shénhuà
summary:
Around three thousand years ago, on the continent of Atageru, many races coexisted together — humans, beast-folk, elves, demons…
They maintained peace across the continent of Atageru. However, this balance did not last long, for among these many races, one harbored an overwhelmingly powerful ambition and desire……
